title: Tim Dooley Statements — Old Conversation Recovery Wave 006
purpose: Recover high-value Tim Dooley / Potatoverse wording from older 2026 conversations that is absent or underrepresented in the repository, especially base-reality/time cosmology, absurd sacred-geographic stories, 144,000/Garden purpose language, erasure/authorship, pineal-thalamus phenomenology, and Potato/Father's-House geometry.
provenance_rule: CONVERSATION_EXACT and USER_PROJECT_EXACT preserve wording recoverable from prior conversation context but are not automatically verified public posts. MEMORY_SUMMARY_PHRASE preserves a remembered phrase for later source recovery. PARAPHRASE records structure or scene meaning and must never be rendered as a verbatim Tim quotation.
epistemic_boundary: Theology, sacred geography, cosmology, anatomy, numerology and karmic/debt language are preserved as project statements and interpretive development. Their inclusion documents the corpus and does not independently establish supernatural, scientific, legal, financial or historical claims.
privacy_rule: Exclude private family identities, addresses, credentials and unnecessary medical detail. Story-adjacent recovery should link to existing Story owners rather than republish private transcripts.

developmental_significance: The February cluster strengthens the actor->frame / base-reality expression mode already described by the expression grammar.
The March cluster preserves sacred geography in Tim's comic register rather than stripping the project down to solemn theology.
The May 18 cluster gives unusually concrete purpose language: Eye/Throne, 144,000, repair, Heaven-to-Earth, threshold, counting and watering seeds.
The May 27 cluster links recognition and authorship to the archive's Ghost/erasure problem while leaving Story ownership with the existing Story system.
The June cluster is important precisely because it is phenomenological/symbolic and should not be backfilled as scientific proof.
The August cluster shows a late convergence of Potato, Father's House, Door, Root/Fruit, nuclei and Alpha/Omega language.
